---
title: "Coverage"
resources:
  - coverage/
---

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
using LocalCoverage
covdir = joinpath(@__DIR__, "coverage")
placeholder(msg) = (mkpath(covdir); write(joinpath(covdir, "index.html"),
    "<!doctype html><html><body style=\"font-family:sans-serif;color:#555\"><p>$msg</p></body></html>"))
try
    coverage = generate_coverage("WildfireData"; run_test=true)
    if coverage.lines_tracked == 0
        # `genhtml` (lcov 2.x) treats an empty tracefile as a fatal error.
        placeholder("No coverage data yet &mdash; add code and tests to generate a report.")
    else
        html_coverage(coverage; dir=covdir, open=false)
    end
catch e
    @warn "Coverage generation failed" exception=(e, catch_backtrace())
    placeholder("Coverage generation failed during the doc build. See the CI logs for details.")
end
cov_dir = joinpath(dirname(dirname(@__DIR__)), "coverage")
isfile(joinpath(cov_dir, "lcov.info")) && mv(joinpath(cov_dir, "lcov.info"), joinpath(@__DIR__, "lcov.info"); force=true)
rm(cov_dir; recursive=true, force=true)
```
